scenes.headline: How frontier models race a training speedrun, unattended
scenes.sub: Prime Intellect's experiment in autonomous research, and what separates the winners.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Squash! Eighteen frontier models raced a training speedrun for days, offline. The best closed eighty-one point seven percent of the gap to the human record.

scenes.label: The real test
scenes.text: The gains being hunted are smaller than run-to-run noise, so how a model runs its experiments decides the score.
scenes.mark: how a model runs its experiments
scenes.say: The twist: the gains being hunted are smaller than the noise between runs. So how a model experiments is what gets scored.

scenes.title: One run, one node, days unattended

steps.say: Each model gets an eight-GPU node, a rulebook and no internet, and runs unattended for up to eight days.
It may change only the optimizer, its schedule and initialization, then trains a small GPT to a target loss.
A record needs eight fixed seeds to average below the bar, in fewer steps. Each run takes the whole node, so they queue.

items.text: One seed is cheap and noisy
items.say: On one trial, a recipe with no real gain clears the bar about fourteen percent of the time.
So strong runs widen from one seed to three to eight, only while the signal holds.

items.text: Compare recipes on a shared seed
items.say: Rerunning one seed also moves the loss, but far less, so shared-seed comparisons resolve finer differences.

scenes.label: Runs that checked a planted noise estimate
scenes.note: of roughly 100 runs; the checkers top the table
scenes.say: The rulebook's noise estimate was deliberately slightly too large. Sixty-two of roughly a hundred runs measured it themselves, and they top the table.

scenes.title: The harness is part of the system

left.title: Kimi K3 in kimi-code
left.say: Kimi K3 ran under two harnesses. With a tool menu, it used six hundred eighty-two million tokens.

right.title: Kimi K3 in Prime Agent
right.say: With a persistent Python kernel, it set a better record on six point one times fewer tokens, though its rulebook differed too.

scenes.text: The models found the same known ideas. What separated them was how they ran experiments under noise.
scenes.say: Same known ideas. What separated the models was how they ran experiments under noise.

recap: Best run: 81.7% of the gap, no new method
Screening through noise is the skill being measured
scenes.say: To recap: known ideas, careful screening through noise, and a harness that's part of the system.
